processes.credit_report_rebook_distribution: Daily credit report listing counterparties to rebook or pending actions is received, forwarded to the book-keeping analyst, and the listed deals are rebooked or credit reserves taken.
processes.deal_correction_request_handling: Requests from other desks to fix a Sitara deal (price update, rebook to another counterparty, flip books, missing deal for an invoice, unconfirmed trade) are looked up, corrected and confirmed back.
processes.nightly_postid_book_check: Instructions and reminders for the nightly Post ID officialization, book queries and imbalance sign-off, including who signs off and how to change deals affecting other books.
processes.analyst_staffing_cost_center_setup: Responding to HR or staffing requests with location, department, company and cost center details so analysts can be placed in the risk group.
processes.misrouted_request_redirect: Redirecting requests that belong to another desk or person to the right owner with a short note.
processes.trading_book_pipe_mapping: Deciding which pipes or counterparties are mapped to new business units or books so traders can book deals.
